title: Record no-commit-without-explicit-user-prompt policy
objective: Update Tower operating instructions and project memory so future Tower sessions do not create commits or route Git-master to commit unless the user explicitly asks for a commit/check-in.
instructions: Record the new user preference: no committing without the user explicitly prompting for a commit/check-in.
Update the appropriate Tower instruction/preference docs, including project-local Tower instructions if applicable, without changing product code.
Update operational memory/current status so future sessions resume with this policy visible.
Preserve existing Tower delegation rules and clarify that Git-master can still inspect status/diffs when requested, but commits require explicit user authorization.
definition_of_done: Future Tower sessions can discover that local commits are forbidden unless the user explicitly asks to commit or check in code.
